description: Explains Niels Langereis's skill-matrix gap analysis: a competency matrix run for formation rather than efficiency, to find where AI has removed the work that used to turn juniors into seniors. Includes the status rule, how to read it, a worked example and credits. Use before run_skill_matrix if the user wants to understand the method first.
name: get_skill_matrix_method
title: Skill-matrix gap analysis: the method
